isUnitOverridden.description: True if the dimension unit is overridden.

isVisible.description: True if the dimension unit is shown in the dimension text. Needs isUnitOverridden true; a dimension that follows the drawing unit also follows whether the drawing shows it. True is refused otherwise; false is always accepted.

isDualUnitOverridden.description: True if the dimension dual(secondary) unit is overridden.

isDualUnitVisible.description: True if the dimension dual(secondary) unit is visible in the dimension text.

dualPrecision.description: Decimal places of the dual(secondary) value, 0 to 8. For fractional units it is the denominator exponent: 4 means 1/16, as for precision. Out of range is refused. The Styles panel offers 0 to 6, but an imported drawing can carry up to 8. Refused on angular dimensions, which have no dual value, and on hole callouts, whose dual precision cannot be overridden.

isDualPrecisionOverridden.description: True if the dimension sets its own dual(secondary) precision. False makes it follow the drawing's default value. Send true to keep a dualPrecision overridden even when it equals the drawing's default value, so it does not change when the drawing's default value changes.
